summary: Native-share security review: no video upload to product APIs; shareVideoFile only from Share onClick (never onstop/effects); secret scan clean; filename allow-list climb-{round(peakY)}m-{yyyyMMdd}.{mp4|webm}; AbortError → aborted with no UI message/stack; share title is file.name and shareError is React text (no XSS sinks). Zero critical findings. Free-leaderboard trust boundary remains open/out of scope.
goal: After downloading climb replay video, allow sharing via Apple & Android native share sheets (Web Share API files).

findings.issue: NFR-NS-4 / parent NFR-6 held: share and export paths contain zero fetch/XHR/sendBeacon/WebSocket/FormData/upload. downloadBlob uses createObjectURL + <a download> only; shareVideoFile calls navigator.share with local File. Native-share commits touch no app/app/api, db, prisma, or middleware.
findings.reproduction: rg fetch|XMLHttpRequest|sendBeacon|WebSocket|/api/|upload across shareVideoFile, useReplayExport, ReplayTransportBar, exportMime, exportVisibility — empty. git diff ace0a77^..HEAD --name-only -- app/app/api app/src/db app/prisma app/middleware.ts — empty.
findings.fix: None. Keep share client-only File → OS sheet.

findings.issue: Gesture safety confirmed: sole production caller of shareVideoFile is Share button onClick. useReplayExport onstop builds File, downloads, setStatus(success) — never calls share. No useEffect invokes share on success transition (ADR-NS-1 / NFR-NS-1).
findings.reproduction: rg shareVideoFile|navigator.share in useReplayExport — empty. ReplayTransportBar mounts share only inside onClick after canShareVideoFile gate.

findings.location: git diff ace0a77^..HEAD (app product + share modules)
findings.issue: Secret scan clean on native-share delta: no api keys, INTERNAL_TOKEN, Stripe secrets, or private key material. No package.json / lockfile changes in this delta (pre-existing pnpm audit highs remain out of scope; next already past Aug 29 critical pin).
findings.reproduction: git diff ace0a77^..HEAD -G '(api[_-]?key|secret|password|Bearer |sk_live|INTERNAL_TOKEN|BEGIN .*PRIVATE)' — empty; package/lock untouched.

findings.issue: Filename remains allow-listed: climb-${Math.round(peakY)}m-${utcDigitStamp}.${mp4|webm}. Extension from pickExportMime enum only; date is UTC digit stamp; no path separators or user-controlled strings. Share title uses the same file.name.
findings.reproduction: Confirm filename interpolates only Math.round(peakY) + yyyyMMdd digits + mime.extension allow-list; downloadBlob sets a.download then blob: URL.
findings.fix: Optional hardening: coerce non-finite peakY to 0 before filename (NaN/Infinity would yield climb-NaNm-… which is ugly but not traversable).

findings.issue: AbortError classified by err.name → { reason: 'aborted' } with no message field; bar returns quietly without setShareError. Non-abort uses Error.message only (never err.stack); empty message falls back to 'Share failed'. shareError rendered as React text child — no innerHTML/dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
findings.reproduction: shareVideoFile.test.ts AbortError → aborted; bar aborted branch has no setShareError. rg innerHTML|dangerouslySetInnerHTML|.stack on share modules — empty for sinks.
findings.fix: None required. Optional: map non-abort to fixed UI strings instead of forwarding browser Error.message.

findings.issue: XSS via share title/text: title is file.name (allow-listed climb-… pattern); text option unused by bar. canShare probe is files-only (no title/text). UI error path uses React text interpolation — escapes HTML.
findings.reproduction: Bar passes title: file.name only; shareError in JSX text child; no HTML sinks in share modules.

findings.issue: Trust boundary #1 untouched: postRun still gated with `if (!finished || posted || replaying) return`. Native-share adds no score writes. Free-leaderboard open question remains out of scope (product-spec/architect exception).
findings.reproduction: ClimbScene finished effect retains replaying early-return; no API/db diffs in native-share commits.
findings.fix: None for this feature. Do not mark free-leaderboard F-1 closed.

learnings.insight: Native-share security review: 0 critical, 0 warning, 7 info. Confirmed no video upload, share-only-on-click, clean secrets, allow-listed filename, AbortError quiet (no stack/UI leak), React-escaped shareError + allow-listed share title.
learnings.action: Proceed to qa-acceptance; do not loopBack to implementer for security.

learnings.insight: Web Share file path stays a client-only trust boundary when: (1) File retained locally past download URL revoke, (2) share() only in a click handler, (3) AbortError mapped to a reason enum without surfacing message/stack, (4) share title derived from allow-listed filename not free text.
learnings.action: When extending share copy, keep title/text from allow-listed or static strings; never POST bytes; never call share from onstop/effects.

learnings.insight: Free-leaderboard trust-boundary ping remains open and out of scope for native share; this delta adds no server upload and no new score writes.
learnings.action: Do not mark F-1 / free-leaderboard AC closed when reviewing share. Confirm share path stays client-only File to OS sheet.
